events.title: 3rd Annual Battle of the Bands
events.description:
Turning Blue Monday into the Best Monday Ever! 💙
January 18, 2027 | Maxwell’s Concerts & Events | Doors Open at 6:30 PM 
Blue Monday is about to get a whole lot louder! 🎸 
The Accelerator Centre’s third annual Battle of the Bands: Tech Edition is back, bringing Waterloo Region’s tech community together for a night of live music, friendly competition, and support for founder mental health. 
Over the past 2 years, we’ve raised nearly $15,000 for CMHA Waterloo Wellington, proving that our tech community knows how to rock for a good cause. This year, we’re turning up the volume! 
Building a company can be an incredible journey, but it comes with real challenges. Long hours, financial pressures, uncertainty, and the responsibility of leading a team can take a toll on founders’ mental health. We believe supporting entrepreneurs means supporting the people behind the businesses, too. 
That’s why we’re bringing founders, startup teams, alumni, industry partners, and friends together on Blue
